findings.evidence: Symmetries.lean:453 `theorem favored_valenceStepFrag_ne_unfavored (hi : IsValenceFlavor valence h i)` — `valence` is the free section variable, no `HadronMultiplet`; Symmetries.lean:430 `theorem chargeConjRelation_valenceStepFrag (C : HadronMultiplet Hadron Flavor)`.
findings.fix: Qualify the sentence the same way: state only that the two combinations differ at `z = 1/2` (1 vs 1/2), and point to `chargeConjRelation_valenceStepFrag` / `exists_chargeConjRelation_and_flavorSymmetryRelation_favored_ne_unfavored` for the multiplet case where the relation holds.
findings.issue: The docstring of `favored_valenceStepFrag_ne_unfavored` claims unqualified that "`valenceStepFrag` satisfies that relation" (the charge-conjugation relation), but the statement quantifies over an arbitrary `valence : Hadron → Finset (Species Flavor)`, for which no charge-conjugation relation is established or even available; `chargeConjRelation_valenceStepFrag` (line 430) requires `C : HadronMultiplet`. The definition's own docstring (line 386) gets this right with "on a multiplet".

findings.evidence: grep over `code/EpsilonEridani` for `pionContent|structure ValenceContent|FlavorRelation|favored_partonConj` returns only `favored_partonConj_eq_unfavored` (Symmetries.lean:307) and no hit for the other three; ValenceContent.lean:179 `structure HadronMultiplet`, :382 `def pionMultiplet`, Symmetries.lean:110 `abbrev FlavorSymmetryRelation`.
findings.fix: Update the description to the names actually landed, so the merge commit does not record an obsolete API.
findings.issue: The PR description documents declaration names that do not exist at the head commit: it describes a `ValenceContent` structure and `pionContent` (the code has `HadronMultiplet` and `pionMultiplet`), `FlavorRelation` (code: `FlavorSymmetryRelation`), `favored_partonConj`/`unfavored_partonConj` (code: `favored_partonConj_eq_unfavored`/`unfavored_partonConj_eq_favored`), and `exists_chargeConjRelation_and_flavorRelation_favored_ne_unfavored` (code: `..._and_flavorSymmetryRelation_...`). It also attributes `IsValenceFlavor` to `ValenceContent`, whereas it is `Parton.IsValenceFlavor valence h i`.

summary: Module and declaration documentation is substantive and accurate throughout, with two exceptions: one theorem docstring asserts a property of valenceStepFrag at a generality the file only establishes for a multiplet, and the PR description documents an API (ValenceContent, pionContent, FlavorRelation, favored_partonConj) that does not exist at the head commit.
